gaps: Height units are not printed on the plate or in the brief (Sonoma ground suggests feet; unverified).

Frame ground extent and scale are not stated in the brief (no coordinates, no scale bar), so names per square mile and the mapping of plate density onto z7 hexes (32 atlas px) or the F01-F12 fixture cells cannot be derived from this question alone.
Exact count of river forks, braid channels, dashed-trail segments, thin track lines and contour lines is not recoverable from the 1199x830 raster.
The clipped green disc at the left edge is not legible; that it is shield "1" is inferred from todo-inputs.json, not read from the plate.
Truncated names: the top-edge height "1,332", the right-edge peak "Rock... Mount..." 1,719, "High Point...", "Bohemian...", "Santa...", "R...", and "Duncans Mills" cannot be fully read.
Whether Lookout Mountain, River Overlook and High Point lack a printed height by design or only because of the crop is not established.
Reserve boundaries (washes vs dashed outlines) are not measured as polygons; the 12.6% wash share is a crude colour threshold with false positives.
summary: Plate one prints 49 fully legible names on a 1199x830 frame (27 ▲ landforms of which 25 carry heights from 797 to 2,205, 19 dot/town labels, 3 reserve washes), far more than the brief lists (7 peaks, 5 homesteads, 3 reserves, 4 knot names). It also holds a single continuous rust coast road continuing up the valley, a gold secondary road through Cazadero, 2 highway shields (one clipped), one braided reach at lower right, three trail line types and an unlabeled flat-blue sea. The lower-right knot actually contains nine place names, not four, and no river or creek is named anywhere on the plate.
